nodes.name: .oxfmtrc.json
nodes.summary: Root oxfmt configuration for print width, quotes, Vue script/style indent, LF endings, and experimental import/package.json sorting, ignoring paths from .gitignore.

nodes.name: .oxlintrc.json
nodes.summary: Root oxlint rules for browser/node ES2024, Vue compiler macros as globals, correctness/suspicious categories, and plugins including vue, typescript, and import.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON-with-comments listing Vue macros such as defineProps as readonly globals so no-undef does not fire.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Short project overview for the Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite monorepo, documenting init, commitlint, lint, format, and spellcheck scripts.

nodes.name: cspell.json
nodes.summary: CSpell dictionary for English and zh-CN covering apps/packages and repo docs, with Vue/TypeScript dictionaries and project-specific words such as oxfmt and grittyui.

nodes.name: lefthook.yml
nodes.summary: Lefthook git hooks that run oxfmt, oxlint, and cspell on staged files at pre-commit, and commitlint on commit-msg for Conventional Commits.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML glob-filtered staged-file commands plus a commit-msg hook invoking commitlint.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root pnpm workspace manifest for gritty-lots: lint/format/spellcheck scripts plus admin-app dev, build, and preview via --filter @gritty-lots/admin.

nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.summary: pnpm workspace membership for apps/* and packages/*, with allowBuilds disabling native postinstall for lefthook, core-js, vue-demi, and @parcel/watcher.

nodes.name: skills-lock.json
nodes.summary: Lockfile pinning Understand-Anything plugin skills (understand, chat, dashboard, domain, figma, and related) to GitHub sources and content hashes.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Solution-style TypeScript root with @gritty-lots/* path aliases into packages/*/src and project references to the admin app and node tsconfigs.
nodes.languageNotes: Empty files array with references to apps/admin/tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json.
